limits: A dedicated single held reference voice measures digital output units, not subjective loudness, polyphony, or analogue console output.
The independent pilot proves capture-input sample order only; it does not prove every primary SCSP core frame or a physical audio deadline.
CurrentFrame anomalies are retained as diagnostics and do not alone invalidate continuous pilot PCM.
Browser engines use the actual shipped WASM/AudioWorklets; no Native audio device is opened. Native parity is tested separately.
SCSP uses full-range signed PCM16, one held slot and no DSP/FM/LFO; the existing fixed-rate host resampler remains in the measurement.
The target and 153 historical measurements are immutable; only SCSP gains may be derived from this extension.
